candidateDefinition.source: the author's UI-automation procedure v3.3, safety section 3 (TODO-52 D1, approved 2026-10-16)
candidate: inside the observation scope: every write surface's declared defaults and this run's resolved values, their isolation locations (surface-list.json scope entries), harness-owned locations (observation context) and the shell record locations (shellRecordLocations); a shared location enters only by the surface's own name pattern, else the surface is a blind spot
carries a harness marker (a run ID of the observation context) in its name, or in registry value data (snapshot flag m; files by name only)
a process of the registered image or its descendants (owned-process ledger)
candidateDefinition.notCandidate: everything else: not classified, not unknown, never blocking; counted and listed locally as unattributed
candidateDefinition.perProcessRecord: not used (TODO-52 D2): no per-process write record; residual risk stated in surface-list.json (framework rows, status blind-spot)
candidateDefinition.osRunRecords: records the OS keeps about a process's own run and windows stay other-actor even with a marker (osRunRecords)

backgroundFiltersSchema.pattern: Python regular expression, full match, case-insensitive, on the redacted target (<CATEGORY>\relative path; a registry value as <HKCU>\key\value name)
backgroundFiltersSchema.reason: why the change is another actor's background activity
backgroundFiltersSchema.evidencedBy: the observed run whose artefacts evidence it; adding or changing a filter is a rule change (HUM-07, A3)
backgroundFiltersSchema.entry: optional: any (default), file, directory, key or value; restricts the filter to that entry kind
backgroundFiltersSchema.scope: a filter may not cover an observation-scope location, a shell record location, a marker item or an owned-process item: stage0.py refuses an overlapping filter at rule load (literal prefixes compared, conservatively) and never applies a filter to a marker item

osRunRecordsSchema.pattern: Python regular expression, full match, case-insensitive, on the redacted target (as backgroundFilters)
osRunRecordsSchema.entry: optional: any (default), file, directory, key or value
osRunRecordsSchema.reason: which OS record of a process's own run or windows it is (prefetch, window session, compatibility store, display-name cache, background activity)
osRunRecordsSchema.evidencedBy: the observed run or procedure category that evidences it
osRunRecordsSchema.use: applies to candidates only (scope or marker items); classified other-actor even with a marker; may not cover a scope location (refused at load)

registryMarker.retention: No automatic deletion; author approval required for each cleanup
registryMarker.dataEvidence: Run ID is encoded in the exact key; verify value payload when the trace export exposes it

unknownOpcodePolicy: unknown; no blanket provider or PID exclusion
externalConnectionPolicy: Studio has no authorised network destination; any attributed connection is undeclared
framing: An observed run measures what running Studio leaves on the machine, whichever layer does it. Effects issued in the Studio process by the WPF/.NET runtime, the Windows text-input framework or an in-process driver are app effects; only OS records that observe the process itself (prefetch, background-activity, compatibility stores) are other-actor records.

declaredAppSurfaces.residualRisk: The user's IME composition-window position (HKCU) is updated by the text-input framework on the Studio UI thread.

declaredAppSurfaces.scope: write-only-within-file: WriteFile into the existing file; no create, delete, rename or set-information
declaredAppSurfaces.residualRisk: The GPU driver's per-application timestamp store (machine-wide) is updated by the in-process driver.

shellRecordLocations.scope: keys and values added or updated during a confirmed export; no removal
shellRecordLocations.residualRisk: The Windows common save dialog (comdlg32, in Studio's process) records each confirmed file in the user's per-extension recent list and the last folder per application, as for every application that uses the dialog. Studio itself stores no folder or setting.
shellRecordLocations.kind: save / open dialog history (shell record location: data the app handed the shell)

shellRecordLocations.status: confirmed (declared with E6; not yet observed)
shellRecordLocations.residualRisk: The shell may add a recent-document link for a file the user confirms in the save dialog, as for every application that uses the dialog: the same record family as the dialog's history (E6, author 2026-10-16).
shellRecordLocations.note: Studio's default export names and the harness-typed names report-<run-id>.<ext> (D4); other links (folders) are outside the scope and only counted as unattributed

shellRecordLocations.blindSpot: HKCU ...\Explorer\RecentDocs: per-extension lists shared with every application, numbered values, no name pattern of Studio's own; an entry naming a harness-typed export carries the run ID in its value data (D4) and is a candidate by its marker; the MRUListEx order value carries none

<APPDATA>\Microsoft\Windows\Recent\AutomaticDestinations and CustomDestinations: file names derive from the application ID, not from a name pattern of Studio's own, and file content is not scanned for markers

shellRecordLocationsSchema.scope: registry: hive run-user, keyPattern (regular expression relative to HKCU) and valueNamePattern; file: root (snapshot root category) with relativePattern or relativePath
shellRecordLocationsSchema.decision: present when the location is also a declared surface (E6): its changes classify as declared; otherwise a change there is a candidate classified as any other
shellRecordLocationsSchema.blindSpot: present instead of a scope entry when the location has no name pattern of the surface's own

otherActorRecords.status: recommended rule change; pending author approval (HUM-07)
otherActorRecords.actor: OS kernel Background Activity Moderator (observes the owned process; not issued by it)
otherActorRecords.valueName: the owned process's own image device path (from its ImageLoad / image rundown)
otherActorRecords.timing: at or after the owned process's ProcessEnd event

basicInformationSequence.status: recommended rule change; pending author approval (HUM-07)
basicInformationSequence.sequence: CreateFile(FILE_OPEN) -> SetInformation(FileBasicInformation) -> QueryInformation -> CloseFile on one file object and thread

basicInformationSequence.changeTime: stage0.py change-times after the probe: each destination's ChangeTime must predate the launch and its first qualified set; otherwise the effect stands
